query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

action.query: Massachusetts unemployment maximum weekly benefit amount 2026
queries: Massachusetts unemployment maximum weekly benefit amount 2026

annotations.title: How unemployment insurance benefits are determined | Mass.gov

content.text:
In **Massachusetts**, the **maximum unemployment benefit is $1,105 per week** for claims filed on or after **October 5, 2025**. Your actual weekly amount is generally about **50% of your average weekly wage**, up to that cap. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))

Massachusetts also generally allows up to **30 weeks** of regular unemployment benefits, so the maximum regular total could be about:

**$1,105 × 30 weeks = $33,150**

If you have dependent children, you may also qualify for a **dependency allowance** of **$25 per dependent child per week**, capped at **50% of your weekly benefit amount**.
